blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-time voice agents need a speech recognizer that never waits for future audio and whose memory per call does not grow with the length of the call. We present E-Gaborformer, a strictly causal encoder that combines Gated DeltaNet-2 recurrent layers with sliding-window attention in a 3:1 ratio, and builds every temporal convolution from a fixed dictionary of causal Gabor atoms. Its streaming state is constant, about 19 MB per call at production scale including the prediction network, where a causal-attention encoder of the same size accumulates over 1 GB after ten minutes. In a controlled causal study on LibriSpeech, E-Gaborformer leaves the initial plateau earlier, reaches a given accuracy up to 18% sooner, and matches or beats an E-Branchformer trained with the identical front end and recipe. At production scale, a 0.6B-parameter Hebrew and English streaming transducer built on E-Gaborformer has 28 to 31% lower word error rate (WER) than NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming, a model of the same size, on English voice-agent traffic, and up to 20% lower Hebrew WER than our previous production system. The same weights serve strictly causal and 480 ms-lookahead decoding with no loss in accuracy, and a two-class formulation of the RNN-T lattice trains the transducer 2.6x faster with exact loss and gradients.
blocks.zh: 实时语音代理需要一个语音识别器,它永远不会等待未来的音频,并且每个呼叫的内存不会随着呼叫的长度而增长. 我们提出E-Gaborformer, 一种完全因果编码器, 将 Gated DeltaNet-2 经常层和滑窗的注意力结合成 3:1 比例, 并且从一个因果 Gabor 原子的固定字典中构建出每一个时间演化。 其流线状态不变,在生产规模下,包括预测网络中,大约每个调用19 MB,一个大小相同的因果-注意编码器在10分钟后累计超过1 GB. 在LibriSpeech的受控因果研究中,E-Gaborformer先离开初始高原,提前达到一定的精度,达到18%,并匹配或击败受过相同前端和食谱训练的E-Branchformer. 在生产规模上,在E-Gaborformer上建造的0.6B参数的希伯来语和英语流传转器比NVIDIA的Nemotron 3.5 ASR的字差率低28%至31% 流体,一个大小相同的模型,在英语语音代理流量上, 并且比我们之前的制作系统低20%的希伯来WER. 同样的权重服务于严格的因果和480ms-lookahead解码,精确度没有损失,RNN-T拉蒂斯的双级配体用精确的损耗和梯度来更快地训练转录器2.6x.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A voice agent must transcribe the user while they are still speaking, for thousands of concurrent calls. Two properties of the acoustic encoder
matter for this setting: causality , so that no output waits for future audio, and a bounded per-stream
state , so that serving cost does not grow with call length.
blocks.zh:
语音代理在用户还在通话时,必须输入数千个同时通话。 相声编码器的两个特性
事件: 因果关系, 以免输出等待未来的音频, 以及每个流的界限
状态,因此服务成本不会随着呼叫长度而增长。

blocks.en:
Most strong ASR encoders, such as the Conformer [ 11 ] and the
E-Branchformer [ 19 ] , are bidirectional. They can be made causal by masking future frames, but
causal self-attention still caches every past key and value: an 18-layer, d = 1024 d{=}1024 encoder at 80 ms frames
accumulates about 110 MB of fp32 cache per minute of audio per caller. Chunked and memory-augmented transformers bound
this cost with explicit truncation [ 44 , 3 , 27 ] . Linear-attention
recurrences take another route: they compress the past into a fixed-size state that is updated once per
frame [ 18 , 43 ] . The delta-rule family, DeltaNet [ 50 ] ,
Gated DeltaNet [ 51 ] and Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) [ 12 ] , has recently closed much of
the gap to attention in language modeling, and hybrid stacks that mix recurrent and attention layers often do better than
either alone [ 4 , 23 , 40 ] .

blocks.en:
We show that a mostly recurrent causal encoder matches attention in speech recognition, and propose
E-Gaborformer. It keeps the E-Branchformer block and changes three things inside it: a 3:1 GDN-2 / sliding-window-attention global
stack, depthwise convolutions built from a fixed Gabor dictionary, and a change to the GDN-2 output gate that keeps the
recurrent branches active from the first update. The result is an encoder with a constant per-call state that trains
faster than its attention-based counterpart and, at production scale, outperforms a state-of-the-art streaming recognizer
of the same size on our English voice-agent traffic.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The Conformer [ 11 ] interleaves self-attention with a convolution
module. The Branchformer [ 33 ] runs attention and a convolutional-gating MLP (cgMLP) in parallel
branches, and the E-Branchformer [ 19 ] adds a depthwise-convolution merge; it matches or exceeds
the Conformer across tasks [ 34 ] . FastConformer [ 39 ] subsamples
8 × \times for efficiency.

blocks.en:
Cache-aware streaming [ 27 ] trains a FastConformer with limited
right context and reuses cached activations at inference; training with several right-context sizes lets one model serve
several latencies; dual-mode and dynamic-chunk training [ 53 , 56 ] pursue the same goal.
Classic streaming recognizers bound the state with LSTM encoders [ 13 ] or truncated attention
context [ 57 , 44 ] . Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming [ 29 ] applies this recipe to a 0.6B-parameter
multilingual RNN-T with a language prompt. Its attention cache is bounded by a fixed left context of 56 frames per layer.
We use the same multi-lookahead training idea; our contribution is the encoder and prediction network, not the
streaming recipe.

blocks.en:
Linear attention [ 18 ] and
fast-weight programmers [ 43 ] recast attention as a recurrence with a matrix-valued state. The delta
rule [ 50 ] replaces additive writes with error-correcting ones, gating adds data-dependent
forgetting [ 51 ] , and GDN-2 [ 12 ] decouples erasing from writing with channel-wise
gates. Structured state-space models [ 10 , 9 ] , long convolutions [ 35 ] and hybrids
of recurrent and local-attention layers [ 4 , 23 , 40 ] show that a few attention
layers recover the exact recall that pure recurrences lack. In speech, Zipformer [ 52 ] and
state-space or Mamba encoders [ 16 ] are recent efficient alternatives to the Conformer.

blocks.en:
Structured receptive fields [ 15 ] and
DCFNet [ 36 ] express CNN kernels as learned combinations of a fixed basis (Gaussian derivatives and
Fourier–Bessel functions). Gabor convolutional networks [ 26 ] modulate learned kernels with Gabor
filters, and GaborNet [ 1 ] learns the parameters of Gabor kernels directly. In speech,
spectro-temporal Gabor filters serve as robust features [ 42 ] and as fixed CNN
kernels [ 2 ] , and SincNet [ 38 ] and LEAF [ 54 ] learn
band-pass front-end filters through their center frequencies and bandwidths. Orukeet [ 41 ] fits a Gabor
function to each nine-tap depthwise kernel of a trained Parakeet model, replaces the best-fitting half by its fit and
freezes it during further training. Our filters are temporal rather than spectro-temporal, act inside every encoder
block rather than at the input, and are constrained to the Gabor span from initialization.

Both training objectives sum the probability of the reference transcript over all of its
alignments to the encoder frames. Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) [ 8 ] adds a blank symbol
and predicts one symbol or blank per frame, independently of the symbols already emitted; we use it in the controlled
study (Section 5 ). In intermediate CTC [ 21 ] , a second CTC loss is computed from the
output of an inner encoder layer through the same output layer (self-conditioned CTC [ 28 ] also

blocks.en: 4.3 Training stalls of GDN-2 branches
blocks.zh: 4.3 GDN-2分部的培训摊位

blocks.en:
Our first hybrid models used the standard GDN-2 configuration, a SiLU output gate and an RMSNorm epsilon of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
Four of the 18 causal runs with GDN-2 layers in round 2 of our screen (Section 5.3 ) never left the
initial CTC plateau within an epoch, the phase in which the model emits only blanks and the loss stays
flat [ 55 ] (Table 4 ). At the first evaluation, after 250 updates, the GDN-2 branch output
had a root-mean-square (RMS) value of 0.005 to 0.006, against 0.28 to 0.38 for the attention branch of the same model,
50 to 60 × \times smaller (Figure 3 , right). We attribute this to the output path: SiLU of a near-zero gate
pre-activation is close to zero, and the recurrence output is small enough to fall below the normalization epsilon, so
RMSNorm does not rescale it. We hypothesize that the rest of the network then learns to work without the recurrent
branch; in the stalled seed, the branch became louder later without the run leaving the plateau.

blocks.en: 6.2 Training
blocks.zh: 6.2 培训

blocks.en:
Training used about 12k hours of Hebrew and 96k hours of English, with Hebrew upweighted in sampling, speed perturbation
and SpecAugment, on three or four H200 GPUs with Muon and AdamW in bf16, with roughly 8,500 s of audio per update. The model with a
two-layer GDN-2 prediction network was trained for 115k updates, and the hybrid prediction network of
Section 6.3 for a further 44k. To shorten training, we used Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming as a teacher during
the first 10,750 updates: its token embedding initialized ours, and two distillation terms were added to the RNN-T loss,
one matching our encoder output to Nemotron’s (through a learned projection) and one matching the transducer’s
blank / next-token / other probabilities on the reference alignment lattice [ 31 ] . The architecture itself was fixed
beforehand by the teacher-free study of Section 5 , and all later training used the RNN-T loss alone.

blocks.en: 6.3 A hybrid prediction network
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 混合预测网络

blocks.en:
We expected a purely recurrent prediction network to have difficulty copying recent tokens such as digits, names and
parts of an address, and therefore apply the encoder’s design to the prediction network: it alternates GDN-2 layers (10 heads of 64) with
causal token attention over the last 128 tokens (rotary positions, RMS-normalized queries and keys), each in a
pre-norm residual block. For streaming, each attention layer keeps a ring buffer of 128 keys and values and a position
counter per stream. The state is therefore of fixed size and can be selected per row in batched frame-synchronous
greedy decoding, exactly like the recurrent state. Step-by-step decoding matches the full-sequence computation to
numerical precision, including after the ring buffer wraps.

我们期望一个纯粹的经常性预测网络很难复制最近的一些符号,例如数字、名称和
将编码器的设计应用于预测网络:它将GDN-2层(64个头有10个头)替换为:
过去128个令牌(旋转姿势、RMS-正态查询和密钥)的因果象征性注意,各在a
标准前残留块。 对于流出,每个注意力层都保留有128个键和值的环缓冲和位置
计数器每流。 因此状态为固定大小,可按批量帧同步选择每行
贪取解码,恰好是反复出现的状态. 分步解码匹配全序计算
数值精度,包括环缓冲包后.

blocks.en:
The hybrid network replaced a two-layer GDN-2 prediction network in an already trained model. Its first and third
layers were copied from the two trained GDN-2 layers and its attention layers initialized randomly. With the encoder and
the token embedding frozen, the new network was first distilled [ 14 ] from the previous model by
minimizing the full-vocabulary KL divergence from the previous model’s output distribution to the new one’s at every
lattice node. Training then continued with the RNN-T loss, the
encoder unfrozen at a reduced learning rate, and optimizer states carried over by parameter name.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
E-Gaborformer shows that a mostly recurrent, strictly causal encoder is a strong foundation for real-time speech
recognition. On LibriSpeech-100 it matched or beat a causal E-Branchformer of the same size
(20.5 / 39.2 against 20.8 / 39.2 after ten epochs) and reached a given WER up to 18% sooner, with a constant
streaming state of about 3 MB. Three ingredients made this work: a few attention layers for exact recall, a GDN-2
output gate that keeps the recurrent branch active from the first update (0 of 36 runs stalled, against 4 of 18), and
Gabor-dictionary convolutions, which led unconstrained ones by 1.2 points at three epochs in the hybrid encoder. The design extends naturally
to the transducer’s prediction network and scales to a 0.6B-parameter Hebrew and English recognizer that serves several
lookaheads from one set of weights, keeps a constant 19 MB state per call, trains 2.6 × \times faster with an exact
objective, and has 28 to 31% lower WER than Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming on English voice-agent traffic.

承认。 在LibriSpeech-100上,它匹配或击败了一个大小相同的因果 E-Branchformer
(20.5/39.2对20.8/39.2 后10个纪元),并提前达到一个特定的WER,达到18%,恒定
流速状态约为3 MB. 3个成分 几层的注意力 精确的召回,一个GDN-2
输出闸门,使经常分支从第一次更新起一直活动(36个中的0个运行停滞,18个中的4个),
Gabor-词典的演化,在混合编码器的三个纪元上,它带领了不受约束的一对一分1.2分. 设计自然延伸
转换器的预测网络和尺度为0.6B参数的希伯来语和英语识别器
从一组重量来看,每一次呼叫都保持恒定的19 MB状态,列车2.6x\时速更快
并且比Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming在英语语音代理流量上低28%至31%。
